wishlist.title: Zeus: Master of Olympus
wishlist.whyHard: Same family as Pharaoh and Emperor, with later UI/media differences to verify under Wine.

wishlist.title: Poseidon: Master of Atlantis
wishlist.whyHard: Expansion-era Impressions build; likely close, but not yet tested with the current wrapper stack.

wishlist.title: Command & Conquer: Tiberian Dawn
wishlist.whyHard: OpenRA-native path is promising; original binary proof needs legacy DirectDraw and installer handling.

wishlist.title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert
wishlist.whyHard: OpenRA can carry gameplay, but the original Windows release still needs a reproducible Apple Silicon recipe.

wishlist.title: Command & Conquer: Tiberian Sun
wishlist.whyHard: Freeware and OpenRA-adjacent, but original DirectDraw behavior still needs a clean capture and input pass.

wishlist.title: WarCraft II
wishlist.whyHard: Commercial sourcing is awkward and the classic release needs old display-mode compatibility.

wishlist.title: WarCraft III
wishlist.whyHard: Classic access is gated behind Reforged-era distribution and later 3D rendering paths.

wishlist.title: Diablo II
wishlist.whyHard: 2D/3D renderer choices and Battle.net-era patching need a controlled Apple Silicon recipe.

wishlist.title: Heroes of Might & Magic III
wishlist.whyHard: Likely wrapper-friendly, but needs proof for the GOG build, expansions, saves, and fullscreen behavior.

wishlist.title: Total Annihilation
wishlist.whyHard: Cavedog DirectDraw plus CD/audio quirks make it a good cnc-ddraw candidate, not a guaranteed pass.

wishlist.title: The Settlers III
wishlist.whyHard: Attempted earlier; still needs a route around the old DirectDraw and installer/runtime walls.

wishlist.title: Anno 1602
wishlist.whyHard: Attempted; community crash-fix DLLs helped, but capture/rendering remained blocked under GPTK.

wishlist.title: Stronghold
wishlist.whyHard: Attempted track has acquisition/runtime walls; likely DirectDraw plus media quirks.

wishlist.title: Cossacks: European Wars
wishlist.whyHard: Attempted; Apple Silicon WOW64 lacks the 16-bit thunk path this build asks for.

wishlist.title: KKND
wishlist.whyHard: Old installer and DirectDraw behavior need a fresh wrapper pass.

wishlist.title: KKND 2: Krossfire
wishlist.whyHard: Likely similar to KKND, with later DirectDraw assumptions and availability checks.

wishlist.title: Black & White
wishlist.whyHard: Attempted; CrossOver fixed early walls, but the D3D7/DDraw layer still produced black frames.

wishlist.title: Sacrifice
wishlist.whyHard: Likely needs patch-level control plus a D3D wrapper path instead of pure DirectDraw.

wishlist.title: Praetorians
wishlist.whyHard: DXVK and resolution pre-edits are plausible, but not yet validated on Apple Silicon.

wishlist.title: Empire Earth
wishlist.whyHard: 3D-era renderer plus patch/distribution differences make it a higher-variance candidate.

wishlist.title: Age of Mythology
wishlist.whyHard: Classic release availability is messy; Extended Edition is not the same target.

wishlist.title: Rise of Nations
wishlist.whyHard: Classic availability and renderer behavior need separation from the modern Extended Edition.

wishlist.title: Civilization II
wishlist.whyHard: Old Windows UI stack and media/install flow need a legal, repeatable route.

wishlist.title: Civilization III
wishlist.whyHard: Later Windows build is more accessible but still needs DirectDraw/input/save validation.

wishlist.title: The Lost Vikings
wishlist.whyHard: Windows release and input handling need verification; not the same as running the DOS version.

wishlist.title: Worms Armageddon
wishlist.whyHard: Community patches may help, but display/input/netplay behavior needs a dedicated pass.

wishlist.title: Z
wishlist.whyHard: Old multimedia stack and DirectDraw surfaces need a clean wrapper strategy.
